versions.localizedDescription:
# SNOOP 0.1.2

This release restores the colorful Today background on iPhone and fixes appearance preset controls.

- Restored the blue, purple and warm day-cycle sky in the dark Liquid Today view, with a subtle header scrim for readable text. Existing Reduce Motion, battery and animation behavior is retained.
- Mint, Ocean, Classic and Frosted presets preserve the day-cycle background's On/Off setting. Midnight is folded into Mint; the background remains an independent control.
- Accent, chart and custom color changes update live on iPhone and macOS 14 or newer, keeping Settings open and retaining screen state. macOS 13 keeps its existing refresh behavior.
- Custom describes a manually adjusted combination and is no longer an actionable preset. Android uses the same preset recipes and independent background preference.

Update the existing SNOOP installation through AltStore using the same signing account, preserving extensions. Permanent app/widget identities, the shared App Group, local storage and backup formats remain compatible. Existing SNOOP downloads, release history and approved artwork are preserved.

The iPhone package includes widgets and Live Activities. The Watch app is compiled but omitted from the sideload package, retaining the existing packaging behavior. This release does not change Bluetooth, HealthKit, calculations, storage or Live Activity controls. Personal signing and device upgrade/data retention still require device acceptance. In-app update checks remain disabled; updates are distributed through the AltStore source.

SNOOP is based on the NOOP project and is independently maintained. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by WHOOP, Inc. It is not a medical device; derived metrics are informational and not clinically validated. Original author attribution, the license and third-party notices remain in place.

# SNOOP 0.1.1

This release brings the approved SNOOP emblem and complete in-app branding to the independently maintained SNOOP app.

- New SNOOP app icon, navy alternative and in-app logo.
- SNOOP naming across screens, pairing help, notifications, accessibility labels, widgets and bundled translations.
- Correct historical attribution to the upstream project in the AltStore/SideStore changelog entry.

Permanent app and widget identities, shared App Group, local storage and backup formats remain compatible with SNOOP 0.1.0. The existing 0.1.0 download and artwork are preserved; the source uses a new versioned icon URL.

The iPhone package includes widgets and Live Activities. The Watch app is compiled but omitted from the sideload package, preserving the inherited packaging behavior. Bluetooth, HealthKit, personal signing and upgrade retention still require real-device acceptance. In-app update checks remain disabled; install or update through AltStore/SideStore.

SNOOP is based on the NOOP project and is independently maintained. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by WHOOP, Inc. It is not a medical device; derived metrics are informational and not clinically validated. Original author attribution, the license and third-party notices remain in place.

# SNOOP 0.1.0

The first independent SNOOP release, based on the NOOP project.

- Permanent Apple identity: `io.0xfaisl.snoop`, with the matching widget and shared App Group.
- Independently maintained sideload builds and source in `0xfaisl/snoop-releases`.
- Existing WHOOP pairing, local storage, health calculations and artwork retained.
- Upstream improvements are selected manually; upstream NOOP releases are not SNOOP updates.

The iPhone package includes widgets and Live Activities. The Watch app is compiled but omitted
from the sideload package, preserving the inherited packaging behavior.

SNOOP is independently maintained and is not affiliated with or endorsed by WHOOP, Inc.
It is not a medical device; derived metrics are informational and not clinically validated.
Original author attribution, the license and third-party notices remain in place.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: SNOOP connects directly to your WHOOP strap over Bluetooth to read heart rate, R-R intervals, battery, and sensor data locally on your iPhone. Nothing leaves your device.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SNOOP records your route during an outdoor workout to show distance, pace, and a map, and keeps recording while the screen is off. The route stays on your device. Nothing leaves it.
privacy.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: SNOOP reads your own Apple Health data on-device to compute recovery, strain, and sleep. Nothing leaves your device.
privacy.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: SNOOP writes the metrics it computes from your strap back into Apple Health, on-device and only when you allow it.
privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: SNOOP reads your iPhone's step count for a walking or running workout to show steps in the activity summary. It stays on your device. Nothing leaves it.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: SNOOP transcribes your question on-device so you can ask the coach out loud instead of typing. Audio never leaves your iPhone.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SNOOP uses the microphone to let you ask the coach a question by voice. The audio is transcribed on-device and never leaves your iPhone.
